questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this controller maps its operations onto HTTP methods and resources? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client sends the same PUT /v1/indexes/products/documents/42 request with an identical JSON body twice in a row, and document 42 did not exist before. What do the two responses look like?
choices: 201 Created both times, each with a Location header, because every PUT is treated as a creation
201 Created with a Location header the first time, then 204 No Content the second time, with the index in the same final state
204 No Content both times, because PUT never creates resources
201 Created the first time, then 409 Conflict the second time because the id already exists

questions.prompt: A client calls GET /v1/indexes/products/search?q=shoes&page=-3&size=500. What does the controller do?
choices: It returns 400 Bad Request because size exceeds the maximum
It returns 200 with the first page of 100 results; the response reports the page and size actually used
It returns 200 with page -3 and size 500 passed through to the service unchanged
It returns 422 because page is negative

questions.prompt: Two clients call POST /v1/indexes with {"name":"orders","shards":4}. The service throws IndexExists for the second one. What does the second client see?
choices: 201 Created with the existing index in the body, since creation is treated as idempotent
500 Internal Server Error, because the exception is not caught in the handler method
409 Conflict with a problem-details body describing the duplicate name
400 Bad Request because bean validation rejects names that are already taken
